artboards: 00-system-sheet (row anatomy inside the list-row example; 'Impact meter — full' block)
source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' #sys: the list-row example's impact cell (row variant, scored + unscored) and the 'Impact meter — full' block; README.md §0.4 'Meters and timeline on every row'
notes: Row variant, scored: the #sys list-row example's first row (impact 7/12, dims sorted [1,1,2,3]) uses 9px-wide bars, heights 6/6/12/18, radius '1px 1px 0 0', sitting on an 18px-tall container with a 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.25) baseline under the bars; the sum sits at margin-left:7px. The fixture reproduces the same scores (cost:1, compliance:1, client:2, operational:3, sum 7/12) so the artboard's own numbers are the comparison.

Row variant, unscored: the #sys example's second row uses a 30px-wide dashed baseline (border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(0,0,0,.3)) at height 18px, plus a plain em-dash — not the Absence small-caps convention. README §0.4 and operator ruling 2.1 both require the Absence convention instead ('the small-caps absence reason from the fixed vocabulary'), which is what the built component renders; the artboard predates that ruling. The width/height/border values below are still the artboard's stated geometry for the dashed line itself.

Full variant track: #sys 'Impact meter — full' block states height:8px, border-radius:8px, background linear-gradient(90deg,#16A34A,#F97316 55%,#DC2626), label column 116px, bar column flex, value column 64px right-aligned tabular-nums 12.5px. The fixture's four scores (cost:1, compliance:3, client:1, operational:2) reproduce the artboard's own four example rows exactly (1/3 Low, 3/3 High, 1/3 Low, 2/3 Med).

Full variant, unscored: the artboard does not show a full-variant unscored state; the built component's em-dash fallback is checked only for basic geometry (dashed baseline width 96px per the component's own row-vs-full branch), not against an artboard value — logged as a gap, not asserted as a mismatch.

children.name: row unscored — Absence reason (operator ruling 2.1, supersedes the artboard's plain em-dash)
children.note: Operator 2.1: 'the small-caps absence reason from the fixed vocabulary ... at 10.5px uppercase/600 #7A6E6C'. Absence.tsx uses font-variant:small-caps (not text-transform:uppercase) at font-size var(--fs-105)=10.5px, weight 600, color var(--ink-3)=#7A6E6C. Selector reaches the Absence element specifically (not the wrapper), which also contains a mobile <style> tag whose CSS text would otherwise pollute textContent.

children.note: dc.html #sys 'Impact meter — full': height 8px, radius 8px, background linear-gradient(90deg,#16A34A,#F97316 55%,#DC2626). The built component's stop is 50%, not 55% — a real divergence, not a harness artefact.

children.note: dc.html #sys: label column is a fixed 116px track (grid-template-columns:116px 1fr 64px). The built component uses a flex row with a 84px label width, not 116px — logged as the comparison value.
